item.title: Weekly Threat Summary — 2026-09-26 — Cyber Threat Wall Weekly intelligence brief
item.description: Threat Signal —. CISA added 10 actively exploited vulnerabilities during the last 7 days. Other is the most represented technology category among this week's new KEVs (6). Check Point has the most new KEV entries this week (2). CVE-2026-48908 is the largest 7-day rank riser, up 761 positions.
